value.rationale: Motivated exact diffusion error under edge-BV input control for two-community networks. The finite-time equality-set collapse when one vertex is added is a nontrivial sharp boundary: all balanced-count cuts maximize on K_{m,m}, only (1,1) and complement survive on K_{m,m+1}, although stationary Poincare has many more maxima. Provides all-time attained error budget and exact rigidity rather than a generic rate estimate.
